2607.25609.title: Contrastive Representation Learning of Longitudinal Disease Trajectories on Temporal Graphs
2607.25609.paper_summary: Understanding disease trajectories from longitudinal clinical data remains challenging due to complex temporal dynamics and heterogeneous patient cohorts. Here, we present a contrastive representation learning framework that models multivariate disease trajectories as temporal graphs and learns representations using contrastive graph neural networks. Nodes represent patient observations over time, while edges capture temporal continuity and structural similarity between trajectories. Structure-aware random walks guide contrastive learning to generate embeddings that preserve temporal context and trajectory topology. The resulting representations enable robust clustering of patients with similar disease progression patterns and reveal latent structure in longitudinal data.
2607.25609.paper_summary_zh: 理解疾病軌跡的長期臨床數據仍然具有挑戰性，這是因為複雜的時間動態和異質的患者群體。<lb/>在這裡，我們提出了一種對比表示學習框架，將多變量疾病軌跡建模為時間圖，並使用對比圖神經網絡學習表示。<lb/>節點表示隨時間變化的患者觀察，而邊緣則捕捉軌跡之間的時間連續性和結構相似性。<lb/>結構感知隨機漫步引導對比學習，生成保留時間上下文和軌跡拓撲的嵌入。<lb/>生成的表示使得具有相似疾病進展模式的患者能夠進行穩健的聚類，並揭示長期數據中的潛在結構。
2607.25609.author: Bastian Pfeifer et.al.
